Your information & your rights

Privacy notice

Version 2026-10-01. Last updated 1 October 2026.

In short

  • I only collect what you choose to send: a contact message, or your email address for book updates.
  • You get an emailed copy of whatever you send, for your own records.
  • I do not sell your information, use advertising trackers, or run analytics on this site.
  • You can unsubscribe, or ask me to delete your information, at any time.
  • Please never send patient information. This is not a clinical service.

Who I am and how to reach me

I am Harni Muharami, an author based in London. I run harni.uk personally and I am the controller of the personal information described here (the person who decides how and why it is used).

  • General enquiries and privacy requests: info@harni.uk
  • Book-update sign-ups and unsubscribe requests: subscribe@harni.uk

Amazon, Instagram, TikTok and the other services linked from this site are separate organisations. They decide for themselves how they use your information and explain it in their own privacy notices.

How the contact and sign-up forms work

Contact form. When you send a message, the site passes it to my mail server, which delivers it to info@harni.uk and sends a separate copy to the address you typed. That copy has a reference number, the date and time, your name, subject and full message, and a note of what you agreed to. Please type your own address carefully: the copy goes there. A contact message never signs you up to the mailing list.

Sign-up form. When you tick the consent box and submit your email address, the site delivers a notice to subscribe@harni.uk and sends a copy of your sign-up to you, with the exact consent wording, the date and time, a reference and how to unsubscribe. I manage the list by hand from that mailbox. There is no automatic mailing service and no subscriber database on this website. Your consent is recorded in that email.

What the page tells you. The form tells you when the mail service has accepted your message, but that does not guarantee it reaches an inbox. If your copy does not arrive, check your spam folder. If the form says sending is unavailable, nothing was sent and you can email me directly.

Not a clinical service. Please do not send patient details, health records, passwords, payment-card details or confidential information about other people. If something sensitive reaches me by mistake I will delete it and, where needed, tell you.

Book-update emails

I will only email you about new books, as you asked. I will not pass your address to anyone to market their own products. Each email will say who it is from and how to leave.

To unsubscribe at any time, reply to any of my emails with the word Unsubscribe, or email subscribe@harni.uk. I will remove you before the next mailing. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything I did lawfully before.

Who receives your information

  • My web host and Cloudflare, who deliver and protect harni.uk and so see the technical data in the table above.
  • My email providers, who carry and store the messages and sign-up notices in the harni.uk mailboxes, and your own email provider, which receives your copy.
  • Professional advisers (for example a solicitor or accountant) and public authorities, only where necessary to deal with a legal matter or to meet a legal duty.

These providers act on my instructions as processors, or in some cases as separate controllers under their own terms. I do not sell your information. I do not use it for advertising profiles, and I make no decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects.

Following a link to Amazon, Instagram or TikTok takes you to that company. Book purchases are made with Amazon: harni.uk does not see your order, your payment details or your Amazon account. I cannot access your Amazon account or see who has bought a book.

Sending information outside the UK

Some providers, including Cloudflare and email services, may handle information on servers outside the UK. Where that happens, UK law requires a safeguard, such as an adequacy decision, the UK addendum to approved contractual clauses, or the UK extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. If you would like to know which safeguard applies to your information, email info@harni.uk.

Keeping information safe

The site is delivered over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection. The forms accept requests only from harni.uk, the recipients are fixed on the server so a form cannot be used to email anyone else, hidden fields and rate limits block automated abuse, and only I read the harni.uk mailboxes. No system is perfectly secure, so please send only what is needed.

If a security incident is likely to put your rights at risk, I will tell the Information Commissioner's Office within 72 hours of becoming aware, and I will tell you without undue delay where the law requires it.

Your rights

You have the right to ask me for a copy of your information, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict how I use it, to object to uses based on legitimate interests, and, where it applies, to receive it in a portable form. You can object to direct marketing at any time, and you can withdraw consent at any time. These rights are not absolute and some have exceptions.

To use a right, email info@harni.uk. I may ask for proportionate proof of identity. I will reply within one month and tell you if I need longer and why. There is normally no charge.

If you are unhappy with how I have handled your information you can complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint. You are welcome to contact me first, but you do not have to.

Children

My books and this website are for adults. Please do not submit information about, or on behalf of, a child. If you think a child has sent me their details, email me and I will delete them.

Cookies and similar storage

This site sets no cookies of its own and stores nothing in your browser unless you choose to save a Pier Run score. The cookies and local storage notice lists each item.

Changes to this notice

If the site changes in a way that affects your information, I will update this page before the change takes effect and change the version date at the top. Older versions that you agreed to are recorded in the emails sent to you at the time.

NHS nurse, clinical educator and author, based in London. I write in a personal capacity. These are my views, not those of my employer. My books give general guidance, not medical advice.
